media_assets_dimensions_positive.name: media_assets_dimensions_positive
media_assets_dimensions_positive.value: ("media_assets"."width" is null or "media_assets"."width" > 0) and ("media_assets"."height" is null or "media_assets"."height" > 0)

novel_daily_stats_nonnegative.name: novel_daily_stats_nonnegative
novel_daily_stats_nonnegative.value: "novel_daily_stats"."views" >= 0 and "novel_daily_stats"."unique_readers" >= 0 and "novel_daily_stats"."chapter_reads" >= 0 and "novel_daily_stats"."chapter_completions" >= 0 and "novel_daily_stats"."library_adds" >= 0 and "novel_daily_stats"."follows" >= 0 and "novel_daily_stats"."ratings" >= 0 and "novel_daily_stats"."reviews" >= 0

chapters_publication_dates_valid.name: chapters_publication_dates_valid
chapters_publication_dates_valid.value: ("chapters"."status" <> 'PUBLISHED' or "chapters"."published_at" is not null) and ("chapters"."status" <> 'SCHEDULED' or "chapters"."scheduled_for" is not null)

novels_publication_dates_valid.name: novels_publication_dates_valid
novels_publication_dates_valid.value: ("novels"."publication_status" <> 'PUBLISHED' or "novels"."published_at" is not null) and ("novels"."publication_status" <> 'SCHEDULED' or "novels"."scheduled_for" is not null)

promo_banners_window_valid.name: promo_banners_window_valid
promo_banners_window_valid.value: "promo_banners"."starts_at" is null or "promo_banners"."ends_at" is null or "promo_banners"."starts_at" < "promo_banners"."ends_at"

coin_ledger_entries_direction_valid.name: coin_ledger_entries_direction_valid
coin_ledger_entries_direction_valid.value:
("coin_ledger_entries"."type" = 'CHAPTER_UNLOCK' and "coin_ledger_entries"."amount" < 0)
        or ("coin_ledger_entries"."type" in ('TOP_UP', 'ADMIN_CREDIT', 'PROMOTION', 'REFUND') and "coin_ledger_entries"."amount" > 0)
        or ("coin_ledger_entries"."type" = 'ADJUSTMENT' and "coin_ledger_entries"."amount" <> 0)
